# truenas_snapshot_rename (Action)

Renames a snapshot (pool.snapshot.rename).



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `new_name` (String) New snapshot name (the part after "@"), e.g. "snap1-renamed". The dataset is taken from `snapshot`; the TrueNAS API is sent the full "<dataset>@<new_name>".
- `snapshot` (String) Snapshot to rename, e.g. "tank/data@snap1".

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force the rename. Only used on TrueNAS < 26.0 (pool.snapshot.rename); ignored on 26.0+ where zfs.resource.snapshot.rename is used.
- `recursive` (Boolean) Also rename the equivalent snapshot on descendant datasets.
